item.title: Diraq Says Quantum Computing Needs a Broader Workforce Beyond PhDs
item.summary: Insider Brief Silicon spin qubit company Diraq has published a blog post arguing that the quantum computing industry’s hiring model which is historically built around doctoral-level candidates – cannot support the workforce scale the sector will need within the next decade. The post cites figures from the Quantum Economic Development Consortium showing roughly 16,500 pure-play […]
